answer: One voyage is one forged identity. The wharf is the register where rows are anchored, so clones collide there. A row opens only when an unrelated sponsor stakes ocean behind it, forfeiting that ocean if the row cheats, and one sponsor backs one row. Ocean is replenished only when strangers trade, so a thousand voyages need a thousand sponsors, each burning ocean nobody else can spend; the pool thins and the bill per voyage climbs. It breaks if sponsors collude or ocean is minted on demand.
